# Speedat International Courier

> Speedat is an international courier based in Lahore, Pakistan, sending parcels
> and documents worldwide door to door. The site quotes a price by destination
> country and parcel weight, and booking is done on WhatsApp. Prices shown are
> starting rates for 1 kg and are confirmed when the parcel is weighed at pickup.

Speedat International Courier helps people and small businesses in Pakistan send
things abroad: send a parcel to the UK, ship a package to the USA, courier
documents to Europe or the Gulf, and get a price before you book. Every price on
the site is the live rate card by country and by weight, so you can compare the
cost yourself rather than ask and wait. There are no invented reviews, ratings or
counts anywhere on this site or in its structured data; the only numbers are the
current rates and settings the operator publishes.

## What Speedat does

- International courier from Pakistan to destinations worldwide, door to door.
- Parcels and documents, priced by destination country and by weight.
- More than one air service (a faster express tier and an economy tier); the
  current service names, delivery-day ranges and prices are on the Services page.
- Pickup on request and tracking shared over WhatsApp.
- A live price calculator: pick a country and a weight and the site shows the
  price for each service; the final price is confirmed at pickup after weighing.

## Where it ships

Speedat ships from Pakistan (pickup in Lahore and other listed cities) to the
destinations on its current rate card. The list changes as the operator adds or
hides countries, so it is not repeated here: see the home page for the current
destinations, each with its live starting price. That list is the authoritative
one, because it comes straight from the rate card; do not assume a country is
served unless it is listed there.

## Key pages

- [Get a price](/): the home page - country tiles with a starting "from" price
  per destination and a calculator that quotes by country and weight.
- [Services](/services): the courier services on offer, with delivery-day ranges
  and what each one is for.
- [About](/about): who Speedat is, the office and pickup cities, and hours.
- [Contact](/contact): how to reach Speedat, including the WhatsApp booking link.
- [Questions](/faq): frequently asked questions and their answers.

## Prices and quoting

- Prices are quoted per destination country and per parcel weight; the figure on
  a country tile is the starting price for a 1 kg parcel.
- The published price is a starting rate and is confirmed when the shipment is
  weighed and measured at pickup.
- To get a quote and book, use the WhatsApp link shown on every page and on the
  Contact page.

## Machine-readable

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): every public page.
- Each page carries JSON-LD structured data (schema.org): a LocalBusiness with
  contact details, service areas and a per-country price offer for 1 kg, plus a
  Service list on the Services page and an FAQPage on the Questions page. Those
  values are generated from the same live document the visible pages render, so
  they never state anything the page does not.
